summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, furnishing a press release of Q2 2026 key performance indicators for its salon business. The report details metrics such as revenue per customer of 7,597 JPY (+5.7% YoY), salon count of 282, and a strategic update on a hybrid staffing model. No special-situation transaction (M&A, tender, restructuring, etc.) is announced; the filing is a routine quarterly business update by the issuer.
